thesis: Physical objects, contact shadows, short springs, a little grain. The page is built around card objects and type as image.

signature_moves.name: Card objects
signature_moves.signature: Cards with edges, contact shadow and a small lift; stack or fan, never a flat grid of clones.

signature_moves.name: Type as image
signature_moves.signature: One display voice, one body face and one utility face doing different jobs.

composition: First screen: one loud line, one quiet paragraph, one action, one proof object.
Second screen: the first signature move at full size; no second hero.
Middle: alternate a dense instrument with a quiet section; break the grid once.
Final: a plain-language close and a real next action; no fake logo wall.

motion.reduced: Freeze transforms and parallax; keep state changes and content.

avoid: Rounded rectangles with no objecthood; ten identical glass cards.
Inter for everything, script body copy, gradient headline as the only identity.
build_order: Write the reference map and the not-doing list.
Set tokens and type; test the first screen without images.
Build the structural signature move; verify at 390px.
Build the behavioral signature; test pointer, keyboard and reduced motion.
Add content, then run the audit and three-width screenshots.
acceptance: One loud line and one quiet paragraph
No copied assets or reference code
caveat: This is a direction. The builder must still study the reference, write original code and verify in a browser.
